name: Ustaad
summary: Tuition academy desk with batches, weekly test ranks, fee status and a drag-and-drop timetable
about: A coaching centre app for a Pakistani tuition academy running Matric, FSc, O and A Level and entry test batches. It tracks batches and timings, students per batch, weekly test marks with class average and rank, monthly fees in PKR and teacher fee shares. The evening timetable is a grid you can drag classes around in, with clash checks.
how: Today shows a live timeline of the day's classes per room; a pink needle moves with the clock and marks the class running now.
Open Tests, pick a batch and week, and type marks. The class average, ranks and the gold, silver and bronze podium update as you type.
Open Timetable and drag a class block to another day or time (or use its move button). Teacher clashes are refused and a free room is picked for you.
Open Fees, switch months, collect a fee or tap Remind to open a ready WhatsApp text to the parent (wa.me link) in a new tab.
Create or edit batches with seats and fees, enrol students into up to three batches, and see each teacher's hours and fee share.
Use Ctrl+K to jump anywhere, switch light or dark from the rail, and reset the demo in Settings.
